# Local OCR data

`chi_sim.traineddata` and `eng.traineddata` come from the official
[tessdata_fast](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast) repository.
They are used by the local, non-provider photo audit to detect text-heavy
Chinese information graphics before any direct source-photo reuse. The
repository licenses these data under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE` here.
